entries.body_md:
The documentation site now uses the same design system as your client portal, so what you read here looks like what you use there.

**What changed**

- Navigation is clearer, and the table of contents follows you down long pages.
- Press Cmd+K anywhere to search.
- The site has dark and light themes and remembers which one you pick.
- This page is new. Every platform update gets published here, and there is an RSS feed if you want updates pushed to you.

More detail is in the [Platform guide](/docs/platform).
